SHOWCASE_VAULT.title: Core concepts
SHOWCASE_VAULT.body:
## Latent variable models #vae #elbo #latent-variables

- **ELBO** — trade-off between reconstruction and KL
- **β-VAE** — scale KL term for disentanglement
- **FactorVAE** — total-correlation penalty variant
- **TC-VAE** — decomposes the KL into MI + TC + dim-wise KL

## Graph prior #gnn #graph-prior

Nodes = concepts, edges = citations or dependencies. See VGAE + GAT + GIN papers in the graph.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  X[image] --> E[ResNet-18 encoder] --> Q[q(z|x)]
  G[citation graph] --> P[GIN prior p(z|G)]
  Q --> KL{KL}
  P --> KL
  Q --> D[decoder] --> R[reconstruction]
```

SHOWCASE_VAULT.title: Experiment conventions
SHOWCASE_VAULT.body:
# Conventions #experiments

- Names: `exp-NN <what> — seed S`
- Every run logs `train_loss`, `recon_loss`, `kl`, `mig` per epoch through the SDK
- Seeds: 1, 7, 13. Seed 42 only for reproductions.
- Artifacts: `train-loss.png`, `recon-grid.png` minimum
- Optimiser: Adam, lr 1e-3, no schedule. See [[Core concepts]].

SHOWCASE_VAULT.title: Thesis argument (one page)
SHOWCASE_VAULT.body:
# The argument #thesis

1. Unsupervised disentanglement is impossible without inductive bias (Locatello 2019).
2. β-VAE-family methods smuggle the bias in through the objective; it is weak and dataset-specific.
3. A citation/concept graph is an *explicit*, *inspectable* bias.
4. Putting a GIN-encoded graph prior on z gives higher MIG at equal reconstruction (exp-03: 0.31 vs 0.22).
5. Ablations show the gain comes from structure, not capacity (exp-06: mean aggregation collapses to baseline).

Risks: dSprites only; downstream benefit unproven (Locatello §5).

SHOWCASE_VAULT.title: GIN proof notes
SHOWCASE_VAULT.body:
# Why sum aggregation #gnn #theory

GIN is as powerful as the 1-WL test because sum over a multiset is injective; mean and max are not.

- Mean loses degree → bad for citation graphs
- Max loses multiplicity

Used in [[Thesis argument (one page)]] point 5. Terms in [[Glossary]].

SHOWCASE_VAULT.title: Reading notes — TC-VAE
SHOWCASE_VAULT.body:
# TC-VAE #vae #disentanglement

KL = index-code MI + total correlation + dimension-wise KL. Only the TC term needs a penalty.

MIG comes from this paper. Sample count matters: [[Metrics cheat-sheet]].

SHOWCASE_VAULT.body:

SHOWCASE_WIKI.body:
# β-VAE objective #vae #elbo

ELBO with the KL term scaled by β. β > 1 trades reconstruction for a more factorised posterior.

{{figure}}

SHOWCASE_WIKI.title: Graph prior
SHOWCASE_WIKI.body:
# Graph prior #graph-prior #gnn

A GIN encodes the concept graph into the prior p(z|G), so structure, not β, carries the inductive bias.

Why sum aggregation: [[GIN proof notes]].

SHOWCASE_WIKI.title: Mutual information gap
SHOWCASE_WIKI.body:
# MIG #evaluation

Gap between the two latents with the highest mutual information for each factor, normalised by the factor entropy. Range 0–1.

Sample counts in [[Metrics cheat-sheet]].
